instruction.text: Match the direct speech with the corresponding indirect speech.

atoms.a: “Have you seen the film everyone is talking about?” Jonathan asked us.
atoms.b: Jonathan asked us whether we had seen the film everyone is talking about.
Stacey yelled at them to hurry up.

atoms.a: “Does it smell strange in here to you?” Harini asked us.
atoms.b: Harini asked us whether it smelt strange in here.

atoms.a: Sam asked us whether we had ever been on a boat before.
Abigail yelled that she had won first place in the competition.
Bernardo shouted at his dog to get off the sofa.
“Did Geoff remember to water the plants before he left,” asked Nina.
“I love the colour orange,” said Vivek, “but I prefer the colour blue.”
“Do you prefer watching TV or playing video games?” Frank asked us.
